thread:
Alex M: Heads up — invoice-preview shows ~0.7% more chargeable tokens after the TTL-ledger rollback we ran at 03:12 UTC. Preview delta > post-replay actual. Anyone else seeing this?
Priya R: Looking now. which tenant(s)? any repro query?
Alex M: Mostly a small set of EU tenants, sample tx: tenant=acme-inc. Repro query: ```SELECT count(*) as tokens, sum(tokens) as total_tokens FROM ledger_events WHERE tenant='acme-inc' AND event_time >= '2026-03-23T02:00:00Z' GROUP BY billing_window``` The preview shows +12k tokens vs final.
Jose L: We had a canary that changed agg_window to 30m at 02:55 for route-priority. Could be aggregation boundary shift + late events.
Leah H: Also saw consumer lag on ingest-side around 03:10-03:20 — DLQ spikes. meter-ingest shows replays landing in next agg window.
metering-bot: alert: ingest_consumer_lag > 120s for shard-14 (03:09 UTC). See /ops/alerts/INGEST-LAG-14
Priya R: Quick check: dedupe TTL is 1h, agg_window is 30m for canary = risk of double-count if event replay duplicates across new window boundaries.
Alex M: here's a short log around the rollback: ```2026-03-23T03:12:07Z INFO rollback started ledger-v2 commit=124556; 03:12:12Z WARN enqueue replay event id=ev_zz123 duplicate-check passed false``` Looks like some replays bypassed de-dupe due to fingerprint key change in the canary.
Jose L: Right — canary changed route_fingerprint from sha1(payload) to sha1(payload + route_tag). That makes dedupe keys differ across windows if route_tag was empty then later set.
Leah H: Console preview builds from snapshots taken from the 'preview' aggregator that still had the old fingerprint mapping; final ledger used new mapping after rollback -> mismatch between preview and replayed ledger.
Alex M: Actionable: revert agg_window to 1h for canary, compute backfill diff for affected billing window, and run a targeted preview re-run. Can we revert now?
Priya R: I can revert the canary flag in feature-flagger (ff: agg_window_override) and trigger a preview re-run job for 2026-03-23T02:00Z-04:00Z. Assigning to me.
Jose L: I'll add a safety check to de-dupe that includes stable_event_id if present, so fingerprint schema drift doesn't cause misses. PR incoming.
Leah H: I'll open a tiny console UX note so preview vs final shows 'snapshot schema version' to reduce confusion for SREs.
oncall-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-03123 (metering-preview-delta). Priority P2.
Alex M: thanks. Priya please post the re-run results here when done. :thumbsup:
Priya R: Will do. starting re-run now — ETA ~8m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Jose L: :eyes:
Leah H: :+1:
metering-bot: job meter_preview_rerun started job_id=rerun-7433332222-1
Priya R: re-run finished. preliminary: preview delta reduced to +0.02%. Uploading final diff report to /reports/instability/7433332222-diff.json
Alex M: nice. keep an eye on related tenants for next 2 windows.
Priya R: also opened PR #1299 with revert and a migration to add stable_event_id check. link: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/1299
Alex M: closing for now — we have rollback + fix + ux note. We'll follow up with postmortem tomorrow. :spiral_note_pad:
